column2: [intro]
I take my pen, open my heart,
On the notepad, I write gently,
My crazy thoughts, my light words,
I am the ink that will charm you.
Writing on notepads is my passion,
A symphony of rhymes and emotions,
With my words, I do pirouettes,
I am the clown of words, the queen of pirouettes.
I draw verses, word plays,
On my white paper, everything soon becomes beautiful,
Ideas flow, it's a whirlwind,
I roll out my ink recklessly.
Writing on notepads is my happiness,
A wordplay that defies the hours,
With my pen, I write cascades,
I am the prince of words, the king of acrobatics.
[ solo ]
On the notepads, my words dance,
They splash the paper, become a dance,
So come, join my light writing,
And together, let's dance to this sincere melody.
[outro]
